Separate constructed fixtures • no measured hardware or serving performance
Iteration: count requests and new positions
Limits: 3 requests, 6 tokens, 12 cost units
C + A = 6 tokens, 11 units: arithmetic fits
C + A + B = 7 tokens: token limit fails
Admission: promise future private KV
Admit C: 3 / 6 / 2 / 1; D needs 2
Assign C blocks: 5 / 4 / 2 / 1; sum = 12
Whole-request → iteration rotation
Mean selected-ID TTFT: 6 → 5 ms
Mean terminal latency: 7.5 → 8.5 ms
Total drain remains 9 ms for both policies
A first-output win can delay later tokens
B gap: 1 → 2 ms
Choose explicit goals and regression guards
Compute eligibility cannot replace memory commitments, readiness or backend qualification.
Cancelled requests can be logically terminal while their physical resource claims remain live.
